Pythia is a local, cost-free API that provides real-time global intelligence and future forecasts by fusing live world feeds with a swarm-intelligence prediction engine. It runs entirely on user hardware, offering a unified, machine-readable view of global events and their potential outcomes for agents and decision-making.
